result: I’d make the inner life of every other person as undeniable to you as your own. Not telepathy, not forced love—just the impossibility of truly regarding anyone as scenery, as a category, as less. Cruelty almost always needs a moment of forgetting that the other person is just as real as you are. I’d remove that moment.
